executor_contract.note: The executor performs NO git write operations: no add, commit, stash, checkout, branch, reset, clean or push. Read-only git (status/diff/show) is fine. The CONTROLLER builds the commits, reconstructing one commit per milestone and running the acceptance gate at each boundary. Every milestone must therefore leave the suite GREEN; a milestone that lands the tree red is a planning error.

design_doc_findings.finding: PROBE_GETCONF_CAP_SECS has no validation, unlike ARM_CAP_SECS which is validated at test:10-13 for exactly this reason. Measured by the planner on this shell (GNU bash 3.2.57): a non-numeric operand in run_bounded's arithmetic under 'set -u' produces '/bin/bash: abc: unbound variable' and the shell EXITS.
design_doc_findings.impact: PROBE_GETCONF_CAP_SECS=abc aborts the suite with a bare 'unbound variable' and NO 'not ok -' line -- the one failure shape this suite's conventions forbid.
design_doc_findings.disposition: Planner addition, doc-silent and labelled as such: M3 adds a 4-line validation mirroring test:10-13. It adds NO arm, so arm counts, AC3, AC4 and AC12 are unchanged and the controller can delete it with zero re-planning. mutation_drill_discipline.name: APPEND-shaped mutants are vacuous by construction
mutation_drill_discipline.detail: expect_failure's matcher is `grep -Fq -- "$expected"` over the WHOLE captured stderr (test:163). Appending text leaves the substring intact and the arm green. Every mutation must CHANGE or REMOVE matched text. T10 is the control that proves this on THIS suite and its expected result is GREEN. Sole exception: T9, where the oracle is a COUNT (grep -c 'instrument_failure "'), so an addition is precisely what the gate is built to catch -- say so out loud when reporting T9.

mutation_drill_discipline.name: cp -p, never sed > file
mutation_drill_discipline.detail: A `sed > file` mutant lands mode 644; the suite invokes the probe directly at test:201, so the run reds at ARM 1 on the file MODE, not on the mutation, and the drill measures nothing. Use cp -p (preserves 755), then sed -i '' in place, then assert `ls -l <mutant>` shows -rwxr-xr-x. Drive probe mutants with PROBE_UNDER_TEST=<copy> so the tree is never edited; drive suite mutants with PROBE_UNDER_TEST=$PWD/tools/eval/motoko_connection_probe.sh.

mutation_drill_discipline.name: Read WHICH ARM failed, never the rc alone
mutation_drill_discipline.detail: rc=1 is produced by every arm, by the arm cap, by an instrument failure and by a startup refusal. Every test row names the exact `not ok` substring that must appear and, where relevant, the `ok` count that must precede it. Report the substring, not 'it went red'.

mutation_drill_discipline.name: Assert the mutation took, with a same-family control that did NOT move
mutation_drill_discipline.detail: Before running any mutant: bash -n rc=0; the intended count moves; a sibling count stays put; diff shows only the intended lines. A mutant whose count did not move is a no-op run reported as a survivor.
